declaration_verdict.note: SINGLE_SOURCE_OK; relation different formulation; the auditor's reading: field (c*d) k \Phi kp p = field c k \Phi kp p * field d k \Phi kp p: a product of two harmonic fields is the field of the convolution c*d, whose support is contained in the sumset of the two supports — the m+m' harmonic bookkeeping of (6.31).

snippet.text:
theorem field_mul {α : Type*} (c d : Coefficients α) (k : ℝ) (Φ : α → ℝ)
    (kp : ℤ) (p : α × ℝ) :
    field (c * d) k Φ kp p = field c k Φ kp p * field d k Φ kp p
